utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Murrieta' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Murrieta is not a Western Community Energy member city (Eastvale, Hemet, Jurupa Valley, Norco, Perris, and Wildomar are); WCE itself deregistered with the CPUC and dissolved via Chapter 9 bankruptcy in 2021. No CCA was found serving Murrieta this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Murrieta/Riverside County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Printed permit and specifications (kept on job site)

value: Schedule inspections through the CSS Portal by 4:30 p.m. for next-business-day service
Maximum of 2 solar projects per company scheduled per day (additional inspections possible with advance notice)
Field representative must sign the IB-133 checklist before inspection
Failed inspections or incomplete work trigger reinspection fees

value.notes: The city states current permit processing is 15 business days.

other_conditions: Properties with zero lot lines do not qualify for SolarApp+ automated permits
All eligible residential roof-mounted solar applications must be submitted via SolarApp+; all other permits go through the CSS Portal

permit_fees.notes: The city's page states a SolarApp+ processing fee applies, and that service panel upgrades and additional inspection visits beyond the first two incur separate fees, but does not state specific dollar amounts.
